title: [Help] Error on InstallerLab Installation
bodyText:
InstallerLab area / Área de InstallerLab
Setup EXE
Question or problem / Pregunta o problema
Received the following error while trying to install InstallerLab:

No window opened to accept the Open Source Maintenance Fee. Also unable to scroll to see the rest of the error message(s).
Steps, FSS or logs / Pasos, FSS o logs
No response
InstallerLab version / Versión de InstallerLab
2.0.0
Windows / Environment / Entorno
Windows 11 64-bit Professional version 23H2

replies.bodyText:
Hi dghoskins,
First of all, I’m sorry for the delay in replying.
I’ve been working quite a lot on InstallerLab over the last few days and, to be honest, I’ve had several nights without much sleep trying to track down and fix the remaining issues.
I saw your report and also your follow-up confirming that the same problem was still present in version 3.0.0. I didn’t want to reply until I had actually found the cause and could tell you that it was fixed, rather than just give you a temporary answer.
I’m happy to let you know that the issue has now been resolved.
Please uninstall any previous version of InstallerLab you may have installed and then install the current version, 3.5.0, to make sure you are testing with the latest fixes.
Thank you very much for taking the time to test InstallerLab, report the problem, and then test it again with the newer version. Feedback like yours is extremely valuable, especially at this stage of the project.
And again, sorry for keeping you waiting — and thank you for your patience and for helping me improve InstallerLab. 🙂
